title: Talent
description: A person associated with a collection or installment, with an optional link to their brand.json identity

role.description: Role of this person on the collection or installment

name.description: Person's name as credited on the collection

brand_ref.description: Experimental (media_buy.collection_cards). Typed link to this person's brand in brand.json, for example a rights-holder brand with right_type talent. When brand_ref and brand_url are both present they MUST identify the same brand (brand_url's host equals brand_ref.domain), and brand_ref wins. Only domain and brand_id are read here; other brand_ref fields are ignored.

brand_url.description: URL to this person's brand.json entry. Enables buyer agents to evaluate the talent's brand identity and associations.
